copy.tagline: 测试Temporal工作流：pytest、时间跳跃与模拟策略。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用Temporal开发工作流，想用pytest测试它们。
copy.tagline_en: Test Temporal workflows with pytest, time-skipping, and mocking.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing Temporal workflows and need reliable pytest testing.

howto.what: 装上后，当你有 Temporal 工作流测试需求，Claude 会给出 pytest 写法：用 time-skipping 快速跑完长流程，用模拟 Activity 隔离外部步骤，用 replay 验证历史一致性，并介绍本地环境和覆盖率设置。
howto.when: 当你说要写 Temporal 工作流测试、问怎么模拟外部依赖或想排查测试报错时，Claude 会使用该技能。

say.text: 怎么在测试里把 Activity 替换成 mock？
say.note: 会加载集成测试指南，介绍模拟方式和错误注入。

say.text: 我要用生产历史记录跑 replay 测试，该怎么做？
say.note: 会提供 replay 测试资源来校验确定性。

howto.what_en: Claude will supply pytest-based test patterns for Temporal workflows: time-skipping for fast long-workflow tests, mocking activities, replay testing for determinism, plus local setup and coverage guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user is implementing Temporal workflow tests or debugging test failures, for example asking for test patterns or local setup.

say_en.text: Write a pytest test with time-skipping for this Temporal workflow.
say_en.note: Creates a WorkflowEnvironment test and explains time-skip.

say_en.text: How do I replace Activity with a mock in my tests?
say_en.note: Loads integration testing guide for mocking strategies.

say_en.text: How do I run replay testing against production history?
say_en.note: Provides replay-testing resource to validate determinism.
